# crucible

> A Go library: the shared Ebitengine app/game engine behind danielriddell21's tool family. Fifteen flat packages covering GUI panels, world generation, title screens, audio synthesis, telemetry, and multi-window plumbing.

crucible is importable as `github.com/danielriddell21/crucible/<package>`. It depends on ebiten, narrata, and ordinex.

Packages: geom (vectors/coords/rects), hud (timed overlay), canvas (software text surface), menu (menu model + Ebiten input polling), store (JSON config persistence), status (cue -> HUD line pipeline), narrate (narrata-backed line rewording), telemetry (generic observer bus), synth (procedural PCM audio), record (GIF/PNG capture), hub (multi-window leader/child coordination), worldgen (BSP dungeons + flood-fill), level (shared world model + generation pipeline: tiles, heights, half walls, lifts, doors, vents, themes, sky), raycast (camera/DDA/billboards + height-aware column walker), camera (2D pan/zoom).

Design rules: app vocabularies (messages, events, cues) stay in each app — packages carrying them are generic; the level package owns the spatial tile vocabulary so world features transfer between games; only menu and camera import Ebiten; the CLI entrypoint stays in each app (crucible is engine code, not CLI plumbing); randomness takes explicit seeds.
